consumer: The mission/dialogue eligibility check that gates the 'turn in package to contact' talk option, asking 'does the engine consider the mission item delivered/deliverable to this contact?'
scope: The engine's mission-item possession predicate over the mission-reachable inventory, honoring the mission-item flag/identity, not merely on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps avatar wielded/worn/inventory items as raw type_id/charges entries, i.e. S-class on-person simulation state, forcing the frontend to re-derive eligibility instead of reading the engine's mission predicate
divergence: Player carries an item whose type_id matches the package but which is NOT the flagged mission item (or the real mission item sits in a reachable container/vehicle the mission predicate counts): carried_items scan returns the wrong yes/no versus the engine's mission-turn-in check
